title: pternandra affinis
intro: Pternandra affinis, commonly known as the White Kuranda Lily, is a plant species in the family Rutaceae, native to Australia. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing, reduce fever, and combat infections. The therapeutic actions of Pternandra affinis include its ability to exhibit antioxidant, antifungal, and antiviral properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents present in Pternandra affinis include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
